_comment: GENERATED from the week labels in data/panels/*.json by deriving each task's span, so the progress bar tracks calendar progress rather than a subjective sense of importance. Phase weight = total weeks in that phase; task weight = weeks occupied x4 (the x4 keeps derived subtask weights integral). Milestones are fixed at 4. Regenerate after changing the schedule; edit by hand only if you want the bar to deliberately over-weight something.
